interface.longDescription: Skills-only packaging of the Zanshin kit: shoshin, kaeshi, yomi, spar, craft, kihon, unslop, checkpoint, whats-next. Ambient practices go in the consuming repo's AGENTS.md (or Pi L0). Pi runtime guards are not included. Design grilling: install Matt Pocock's skills separately.
